description:
Most people don’t undervalue themselves because they lack ability.

They undervalue themselves because they’re looking at their life through a distorted lens.

When you change how you see yourself, you change what you settle for.

And that’s where everything starts to rise.
transcript: Know your true value. It's not ego to understand how valuable you are because you're not your job title. You're not the mistakes of the past. You're not what other people think you are. Your value is your experiences. Your value is your perspective. Your value comes in on how you solve problems.
